body: Hi there! Thanks for the report. I've queued this for a reproduction check on Wails v3. We'll keep this open while we investigate.

Hi there! I reproduced this on macOS and Windows. A fix is queued. Thanks!

<details>
<summary>Test evidence</summary>

Tested v3.0.0-beta.26 ([pinned source](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/commit/41e5b2210813502d87736ab9509f525f95ecd248)). Each VM started from its clean test snapshot and ran offline.

Trigger: A Provider whose Download writes partial bytes into the Updater's destination writer and then returns io.ErrUnexpectedEOF, driven through the public API: Init, Check, then DownloadAndInstall, with TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP pointed at an isolated t.TempDir.

Expected: After DownloadAndInstall returns the download error, no wails-update-* temporary directory and no .artifact file remain in the temp root.

**macOS 26.6.2 ARM64 — reproduced**

```text
go test -json -count=1 -timeout=90s -run ^TestWorkflowReproDownloadFailureLeavesTempArtifacts$ ./pkg/updater
ProductVersion:		26.6.2
BuildVersion:		25G83
go version go1.27.1 darwin/arm64
REPRO_OBSERVATION: partial_bytes_written=20 of 40; during_download dirs=1 artifacts=1; state_after=error; after_failure leftover_dirs=1 leftover_artifacts=1
REPRO_ASSERTION: failed download left temporary files behind: wails-update-* dirs=1, .artifact files=1 (expected 0 and 0)
```

**Windows 11 24H2 ARM64 — reproduced**

```text
go test -json -count=1 -timeout=90s -run ^TestWorkflowReproDownloadFailureLeavesTempArtifacts$ ./pkg/updater
Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.26100.0
go version go1.27.1 windows/arm64
REPRO_OBSERVATION: partial_bytes_written=20 of 40; during_download dirs=1 artifacts=1; state_after=error; after_failure leftover_dirs=1 leftover_artifacts=1
REPRO_ASSERTION: failed download left temporary files behind: wails-update-* dirs=1, .artifact files=1 (expected 0 and 0)
```

The failing regression assertion is the evidence; compilation and setup succeeded.

Scope: a Go package test against this pinned version, simulating the reported failure. It does not establish behavior in every release or exercise the GUI. Screenshots are not applicable. Independent evidence review agreed with these results.

</details>
